scenarios.title: 在咖啡店
scenarios.setting: You're at a café in Shanghai. The barista greets you.

lines.text: 你好！喝点儿什么？
lines.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hē diǎnr shénme?

lines.text: 我要一杯拿铁。
lines.en: I'd like a latte.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi nátiě.

lines.text: 要不要吃点儿东西？
lines.en: Would you like something to eat?
lines.pinyin: Yào bu yào chī diǎnr dōngxi?

lines.text: 我还要一块蛋糕。
lines.en: I'd also like a piece of cake.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yào yí kuài dàngāo.

lines.text: 一共四十五块。
lines.en: That's forty-five yuan altogether.
lines.pinyin: Yígòng sìshíwǔ kuài.

lines.text: 我用微信付。
lines.en: I'll pay with WeChat.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòng Wēixìn fù.

lines.text: 好的，请稍等。
lines.en: OK, one moment please.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng.

scenarios.title: 银行在哪儿？
scenarios.setting: You're on a street downtown and need a bank.

lines.text: 请问，银行在哪儿？
lines.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, yínháng zài nǎr?

lines.text: 一直走，然后往左拐。
lines.en: Go straight ahead, then turn left.
lines.pinyin: Yìzhí zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.

lines.text: 远吗？
lines.en: Is it far?
lines.pinyin: Yuǎn ma?

lines.text: 不远，走路五分钟。
lines.en: Not far, five minutes on foot.
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.

lines.text: 谢谢！
lines.en: Thank you!
lines.pinyin: Xièxie!

lines.text: 不客气。
lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.pinyin: Bú kèqi.

scenarios.title: 买水果
scenarios.setting: You're buying fruit at a stall.

lines.text: 你要什么？
lines.en: What would you like?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yào shénme?

lines.text: 我要一斤苹果。
lines.en: I'd like a jin of apples.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì jīn píngguǒ.

lines.text: 好。还要别的吗？
lines.en: OK. Anything else?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Hái yào biéde ma?

lines.text: 不要了。多少钱？
lines.en: No, that's all. How much is it?
lines.pinyin: Bú yào le. Duōshao qián?

lines.text: 六块。
lines.en: Six yuan.
lines.pinyin: Liù kuài.

lines.text: 给你。
lines.en: Here you are.
lines.pinyin: Gěi nǐ.

scenarios.title: 认识新朋友
scenarios.setting: At a friend's party, someone comes up to say hi.

lines.text: 你好，我叫李明。你叫什么名字？
lines.en: Hi, I'm Li Ming. What's your name?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?

lines.text: 你好，我叫山姆。很高兴认识你。
lines.en: Hi, my name is Sam. Nice to meet you.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Shānmǔ. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
alt: 很高兴认识你，我叫山姆。

lines.text: 你是哪国人？
lines.en: What country are you from?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?

lines.text: 我是美国人，现在住在上海。
lines.en: I'm American, and I live in Shanghai now.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì Měiguó rén, xiànzài zhù zài Shànghǎi.

lines.text: 你做什么工作？
lines.en: What do you do for work?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò?

lines.text: 我在一家软件公司工作。
lines.en: I work at a software company.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā ruǎnjiàn gōngsī gōngzuò.

lines.text: 太好了！欢迎你来上海。
lines.en: Great! Welcome to Shanghai.
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Huānyíng nǐ lái Shànghǎi.

scenarios.title: 看医生
scenarios.setting: You're not feeling well and see a doctor.

lines.text: 你哪儿不舒服？
lines.en: What seems to be the problem?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?

lines.text: 我嗓子疼，还发烧。
lines.en: My throat hurts, and I have a fever.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ sǎngzi téng, hái fāshāo.

lines.text: 从什么时候开始的？
lines.en: When did it start?
lines.pinyin: Cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?

lines.text: 从昨天晚上开始的。
lines.en: It started last night.
lines.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang kāishǐ de.

lines.text: 我给你开点儿药，一天吃三次。
lines.en: I'll prescribe some medicine. Take it three times a day.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ kāi diǎnr yào, yì tiān chī sān cì.

lines.text: 好的，谢谢医生。
lines.en: OK, thank you, doctor.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, xièxie yīshēng.

scenarios.title: 办理登机
scenarios.setting: You're checking in for your flight.

lines.text: 您好，请出示您的护照。
lines.en: Hello, please show me your passport.
lines.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐng chūshì nín de hùzhào.

lines.text: 给您。
lines.en: Here you are.
lines.pinyin: Gěi nín.

lines.text: 有行李要托运吗？
lines.en: Do you have any bags to check?
lines.pinyin: Yǒu xíngli yào tuōyùn ma?

lines.text: 有一个箱子。
lines.en: I have one suitcase.
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí ge xiāngzi.

lines.text: 您要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？
lines.en: Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
lines.pinyin: Nín yào kào chuāng háishi kào guòdào de zuòwèi?

lines.text: 靠窗的，谢谢。
lines.en: Window, thanks.
lines.pinyin: Kào chuāng de, xièxie.

lines.text: 好的，您在十二号登机口登机。
lines.en: All right, you'll board at gate twelve.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, nín zài shí'èr hào dēngjīkǒu dēngjī.

scenarios.title: 上错菜了
scenarios.setting: The waiter brought you the wrong dish.

lines.text: 服务员，我点的是鱼，可是上的是鸡肉。
lines.en: Excuse me, I ordered the fish, but I was brought chicken.
lines.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒ diǎn de shì yú, kěshì shàng de shì jīròu.

lines.text: 不好意思！我马上给您换。
lines.en: I'm so sorry! I'll change it for you right away.
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi! Wǒ mǎshàng gěi nín huàn.

lines.text: 谢谢。要等很久吗？
lines.en: Thanks. Will it take long?
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Yào děng hěn jiǔ ma?

lines.text: 大概十分钟。要不要先给您来点儿喝的？
lines.en: About ten minutes. Can I get you something to drink first?
lines.pinyin: Dàgài shí fēnzhōng. Yào bu yào xiān gěi nín lái diǎnr hē de?

lines.text: 好，再来一杯柠檬水吧。
lines.en: Sure, another lemonade, please.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zài lái yì bēi níngméngshuǐ ba.

lines.text: 好的。这份甜品送您，算我们的。
lines.en: Of course. This dessert is on us.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Zhè fèn tiánpǐn sòng nín, suàn wǒmen de.

scenarios.title: 换衣服
scenarios.setting: You bought a shirt that's too small.

lines.text: 你好，这件衬衫太小了，我想换一件。
lines.en: Hi, this shirt is too small, I'd like to exchange it.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, zhè jiàn chènshān tài xiǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huàn yí jiàn.

lines.text: 您有小票吗？
lines.en: Do you have the receipt?
lines.pinyin: Nín yǒu xiǎopiào ma?

lines.text: 有，在这儿。我是星期六买的。
lines.en: Yes, here it is. I bought it on Saturday.
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, zài zhèr. Wǒ shì xīngqīliù mǎi de.

lines.text: 您是想换一件，还是想退款？
lines.en: Would you like to exchange it or get a refund?
lines.pinyin: Nín shì xiǎng huàn yí jiàn, háishi xiǎng tuìkuǎn?

lines.text: 我想换大一号的。
lines.en: I'd like one size bigger.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huàn dà yí hào de.

lines.text: 好的，我给您拿一件中号的。
lines.en: All right, I'll get you a medium.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ gěi nín ná yí jiàn zhōnghào de.

scenarios.title: 去博物馆
scenarios.setting: You want to visit the Shanghai Museum by metro.

lines.text: 请问，去上海博物馆怎么走？
lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the Shanghai Museum?
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù Shànghǎi Bówùguǎn zěnme zǒu?

lines.text: 你可以坐地铁二号线，到人民广场站下。
lines.en: You can take Metro Line 2 and get off at People's Square.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě èr hào xiàn, dào Rénmín Guǎngchǎng zhàn xià.

lines.text: 在哪儿买票？
lines.en: Where do I buy a ticket?
lines.pinyin: Zài nǎr mǎi piào?

lines.text: 站里有售票机，也可以直接用手机扫码。
lines.en: There are ticket machines in the station, or you can just scan the code with your phone.
lines.pinyin: Zhàn li yǒu shòupiàojī, yě kěyǐ zhíjiē yòng shǒujī sǎo mǎ.

lines.text: 大概要多长时间？
lines.en: About how long does it take?
lines.pinyin: Dàgài yào duō cháng shíjiān?

lines.text: 二十分钟左右吧。
lines.en: Around twenty minutes.
lines.pinyin: Èrshí fēnzhōng zuǒyòu ba.

scenarios.title: 描述症状
scenarios.setting: You've had stomach trouble for a few days.

lines.text: 说说你的症状吧。
lines.en: Tell me about your symptoms.
lines.pinyin: Shuōshuo nǐ de zhèngzhuàng ba.

lines.text: 我肚子疼了三天了，晚上几乎睡不着。
lines.en: My stomach has hurt for three days, and I can barely sleep at night.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dùzi téng le sān tiān le, wǎnshang jīhū shuì bu zháo.

lines.text: 最近吃了什么特别的东西吗？
lines.en: Have you eaten anything unusual lately?
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn chī le shénme tèbié de dōngxi ma?

lines.text: 我觉得可能是在路边摊吃坏了肚子。
lines.en: I think something from a street stall upset my stomach.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde kěnéng shì zài lùbiāntān chī huài le dùzi.

lines.text: 你在吃什么药吗？对什么过敏吗？
lines.en: Are you taking any medicine? Are you allergic to anything?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài chī shénme yào ma? Duì shénme guòmǐn ma?

lines.text: 我没在吃药，但是我对青霉素过敏。
lines.en: I'm not taking anything, but I'm allergic to penicillin.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi zài chī yào, dànshì wǒ duì qīngméisù guòmǐn.

lines.text: 好，我记下了。先去验个血吧。
lines.en: OK, I've noted that. Let's do a blood test first.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ jì xià le. Xiān qù yàn ge xiě ba.

scenarios.title: 行李丢了
scenarios.setting: Your suitcase didn't come out at baggage claim.

lines.text: 你好，我坐的是从纽约来的航班，我的行李没到。
lines.en: Hello, I was on the flight from New York, and my luggage didn't arrive.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ zuò de shì cóng Niǔyuē lái de hángbān, wǒ de xíngli méi dào.

lines.text: 非常抱歉。请给我看一下您的行李牌。
lines.en: I'm very sorry. Please show me your baggage tag.
lines.pinyin: Fēicháng bàoqiàn. Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yíxià nín de xínglipái.

lines.text: 给您。是一个黑色的中号箱子，上面系着一条红丝带。
lines.en: Here you are. It's a medium black suitcase with a red ribbon tied on it.
lines.pinyin: Gěi nín. Shì yí ge hēisè de zhōnghào xiāngzi, shàngmiàn jì zhe yì tiáo hóng sīdài.

lines.text: 系统显示，您的行李还在纽约，明天早上能到。
lines.en: The system shows your luggage is still in New York. It can arrive tomorrow morning.
lines.pinyin: Xìtǒng xiǎnshì, nín de xíngli hái zài Niǔyuē, míngtiān zǎoshang néng dào.

lines.text: 能帮我送到酒店吗？
lines.en: Can you deliver it to my hotel?
lines.pinyin: Néng bāng wǒ sòng dào jiǔdiàn ma?

lines.text: 可以，免费的。请留一下酒店地址和电话。
lines.en: Yes, free of charge. Please leave the hotel address and a phone number.
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, miǎnfèi de. Qǐng liú yíxià jiǔdiàn dìzhǐ hé diànhuà.

scenarios.title: 聊周末
scenarios.setting: Monday morning, a coworker asks about your weekend.

lines.text: 周末过得怎么样？
lines.en: How was your weekend?
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò guò de zěnmeyàng?

lines.text: 挺好的！我们去了杭州，特别喜欢。
lines.en: Really good! We went to Hangzhou and loved it.
lines.pinyin: Tǐng hǎo de! Wǒmen qù le Hángzhōu, tèbié xǐhuan.

lines.text: 真羡慕！人多不多？
lines.en: I'm jealous! Was it crowded?
lines.pinyin: Zhēn xiànmù! Rén duō bu duō?

lines.text: 有点儿多，但是很值得。西湖太美了。
lines.en: A bit, but it was worth it. West Lake is so beautiful.
lines.pinyin: Yǒudiǎnr duō, dànshì hěn zhíde. Xī Hú tài měi le.

lines.text: 我一直说要去，可是一直没去成。
lines.en: I keep saying I'll go, but I never manage to.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí shuō yào qù, kěshì yìzhí méi qù chéng.

lines.text: 你可以淡季去，人少多了。
lines.en: You could go in the off-season; there are far fewer people.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dànjì qù, rén shǎo duō le.

scenarios.title: 订位子
scenarios.setting: You're organizing a work dinner for twelve.

lines.text: 我想订周五晚上十二个人的位子，需要素食和无麸质的菜。
lines.en: I'd like to book for twelve people on Friday evening, and we need vegetarian and gluten-free dishes.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dìng zhōuwǔ wǎnshang shí'èr ge rén de wèizi, xūyào sùshí hé wú fūzhì de cài.

lines.text: 没问题。我们大桌一般是套餐，您看可以吗？
lines.en: No problem. For large tables we usually do a set menu. Is that all right?
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Wǒmen dà zhuō yìbān shì tàocān, nín kàn kěyǐ ma?

lines.text: 要看情况。有过敏的人，菜能调整吗？
lines.en: It depends. Can the dishes be adjusted for people with allergies?
lines.pinyin: Yào kàn qíngkuàng. Yǒu guòmǐn de rén, cài néng tiáozhěng ma?

lines.text: 可以，只要提前两天告诉我们就行。
lines.en: Yes, as long as you tell us two days ahead.
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, zhǐyào tíqián liǎng tiān gàosu wǒmen jiù xíng.

lines.text: 好的，我今天就把具体要求发给你们确认。
lines.en: OK, I'll send you the details to confirm today.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ jīntiān jiù bǎ jùtǐ yāoqiú fā gěi nǐmen quèrèn.

lines.text: 好的。订位需要先付百分之三十的定金。
lines.en: Great. Booking requires a thirty percent deposit up front.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Dìng wèi xūyào xiān fù bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de dìngjīn.

scenarios.title: 保修
scenarios.setting: Your two-month-old laptop has stopped charging.

lines.text: 这台电脑我两个月前买的，现在已经充不了电了。
lines.en: I bought this laptop two months ago, and now it won't charge.
lines.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo wǒ liǎng ge yuè qián mǎi de, xiànzài yǐjīng chōng bu liǎo diàn le.

lines.text: 需要寄到售后维修，大概要三个星期。
lines.en: It has to be sent for repair, which takes about three weeks.
lines.pinyin: Xūyào jì dào shòuhòu wéixiū, dàgài yào sān ge xīngqī.

lines.text: 三个星期太久了，我工作要用。能不能直接给我换一台？
lines.en: Three weeks is too long, I need it for work. Can't you just give me a new one?
lines.pinyin: Sān ge xīngqī tài jiǔ le, wǒ gōngzuò yào yòng. Néng bu néng zhíjiē gěi wǒ huàn yì tái?

lines.text: 按照店里的规定，三十天以内才能换货。
lines.en: Store policy only allows exchanges within thirty days.
lines.pinyin: Ànzhào diàn li de guīdìng, sānshí tiān yǐnèi cái néng huàn huò.

lines.text: 我理解，但这是质量问题。我想跟你们经理谈谈。
lines.en: I understand, but this is a quality problem. I'd like to talk to your manager.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě, dàn zhè shì zhìliàng wèntí. Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐmen jīnglǐ tántan.

lines.text: 我去问一下。这段时间我们可以先借您一台电脑用。
lines.en: Let me ask. Meanwhile, we can lend you a computer.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù wèn yíxià. Zhè duàn shíjiān wǒmen kěyǐ xiān jiè nín yì tái diànnǎo yòng.

scenarios.title: 地铁停运
scenarios.setting: A visitor asks you how to get to the airport while the airport line is closed.

lines.text: 不好意思，你知道怎么去机场吗？听说地铁停了。
lines.en: Excuse me, do you know how to get to the airport? I heard the metro is down.
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, nǐ zhīdào zěnme qù jīchǎng ma? Tīngshuō dìtiě tíng le.

lines.text: 对，机场线今天停运了。最方便的是用手机打车。
lines.en: Yes, the airport line is closed today. The easiest way is to get a ride on your phone.
lines.pinyin: Duì, jīchǎng xiàn jīntiān tíngyùn le. Zuì fāngbiàn de shì yòng shǒujī dǎchē.

lines.text: 会不会很贵啊？
lines.en: Won't it be really expensive?
lines.pinyin: Huì bu huì hěn guì a?

lines.text: 比平时贵一点儿，不过现在走的话，能避开晚高峰。
lines.en: A bit more than usual, but if you leave now, you'll miss the evening rush hour.
lines.pinyin: Bǐ píngshí guì yìdiǎnr, búguò xiànzài zǒu de huà, néng bìkāi wǎn gāofēng.

lines.text: 有道理。从这儿过去要多久？
lines.en: Makes sense. How long does it take from here?
lines.pinyin: Yǒu dàolǐ. Cóng zhèr guòqu yào duō jiǔ?

lines.text: 大概四十分钟，路上堵的话可能更久。
lines.en: About forty minutes, maybe longer if there's traffic.
lines.pinyin: Dàgài sìshí fēnzhōng, lùshang dǔ de huà kěnéng gèng jiǔ.

scenarios.title: 行业酒会
scenarios.setting: At an industry event, someone has heard about your work.

lines.text: 原来您就是负责新项目的那位，久仰大名啊。
lines.en: So you're the one in charge of the new project. I've heard so much about you.
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái nín jiù shì fùzé xīn xiàngmù de nà wèi, jiǔyǎng dàmíng a.

lines.text: 哪里哪里，都是团队的功劳，不过确实挺有挑战的。
lines.en: Oh, not at all, it's all the team's doing, though it really has been a challenge.
lines.pinyin: Nǎli nǎli, dōu shì tuánduì de gōngláo, búguò quèshí tǐng yǒu tiǎozhàn de.

lines.text: 跟深圳那边的团队合作得怎么样？
lines.en: How is working with the team in Shenzhen?
lines.pinyin: Gēn Shēnzhèn nàbiān de tuánduì hézuò de zěnmeyàng?

lines.text: 挺顺利的，他们很靠谱。刚开始时间不好协调，现在已经磨合好了。
lines.en: It's going smoothly, they're very reliable. At first our schedules were hard to coordinate, but we've worked it out now.
lines.pinyin: Tǐng shùnlì de, tāmen hěn kàopǔ. Gāng kāishǐ shíjiān bù hǎo xiétiáo, xiànzài yǐjīng móhé hǎo le.

lines.text: 那就好。改天一起喝杯咖啡，聊聊合作的可能？
lines.en: Good to hear. Shall we get a coffee sometime and talk about working together?
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo. Gǎitiān yìqǐ hē bēi kāfēi, liáoliao hézuò de kěnéng?

lines.text: 好啊，我们加个微信，到时候约。
lines.en: Sure, let's add each other on WeChat and set a time.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒmen jiā ge Wēixìn, dào shíhou yuē.

scenarios.title: 听听别的意见
scenarios.setting: Another doctor recommended surgery; you want a second opinion.

lines.text: 大夫，另一位医生建议我做手术，但我想再听听别的意见。
lines.en: Doctor, another doctor suggested surgery, but I wanted to hear another opinion.
lines.pinyin: Dàifu, lìng yí wèi yīshēng jiànyì wǒ zuò shǒushù, dàn wǒ xiǎng zài tīngting biéde yìjiàn.

lines.text: 你这样做是对的。从检查结果看，我建议先做康复治疗。
lines.en: You did the right thing. From the test results, I'd suggest starting with physical therapy.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò shì duì de. Cóng jiǎnchá jiéguǒ kàn, wǒ jiànyì xiān zuò kāngfù zhìliáo.

lines.text: 不做手术的话，效果好的可能性有多大？
lines.en: Without surgery, how likely is it to work?
lines.pinyin: Bú zuò shǒushù de huà, xiàoguǒ hǎo de kěnéngxìng yǒu duō dà?

lines.text: 像你这种情况，大部分人三个月左右就会好转。
lines.en: In cases like yours, most people improve within about three months.
lines.pinyin: Xiàng nǐ zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng, dà bùfen rén sān ge yuè zuǒyòu jiù huì hǎozhuǎn.

lines.text: 那我想先试试，不想一下子就做这么大的决定。
lines.en: Then I'd like to try that first; I don't want to rush into such a big decision.
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiǎng xiān shìshi, bù xiǎng yíxiàzi jiù zuò zhème dà de juédìng.

lines.text: 这很合理。要是没有好转，我们再考虑别的办法。
lines.en: That's very reasonable. If there's no improvement, we'll consider other options.
lines.pinyin: Zhè hěn hélǐ. Yàoshi méiyǒu hǎozhuǎn, wǒmen zài kǎolǜ biéde bànfǎ.

scenarios.title: 错过转机
scenarios.setting: Your first flight was three hours late and you missed your connection.

lines.text: 第一班飞机晚了三个小时，我错过了转机。我现在有什么选择？
lines.en: My first flight was three hours late and I missed my connection. What are my options?
lines.pinyin: Dì-yī bān fēijī wǎn le sān ge xiǎoshí, wǒ cuòguò le zhuǎnjī. Wǒ xiànzài yǒu shénme xuǎnzé?

lines.text: 最早有空位的航班是明天早上七点。
lines.en: The earliest flight with seats is tomorrow at seven a.m.
lines.pinyin: Zuì zǎo yǒu kòngwèi de hángbān shì míngtiān zǎoshang qī diǎn.

lines.text: 延误是航空公司造成的，所以住宿和餐饮应该由你们负责吧？
lines.en: The delay was caused by the airline, so the hotel and meals should be on you, right?
lines.pinyin: Yánwù shì hángkōng gōngsī zàochéng de, suǒyǐ zhùsù hé cānyǐn yīnggāi yóu nǐmen fùzé ba?

lines.text: 是的。这是酒店住宿券和晚餐券。
lines.en: Yes. Here are a hotel voucher and a dinner voucher.
lines.pinyin: Shì de. Zhè shì jiǔdiàn zhùsùquàn hé wǎncānquàn.

lines.text: 谢谢。今晚那班能帮我排候补吗？
lines.en: Thank you. Can you put me on standby for tonight's flight?
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīnwǎn nà bān néng bāng wǒ pái hòubǔ ma?

lines.text: 可以帮您登记，但不能保证有位子。
lines.en: I can register you, but I can't guarantee a seat.
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ bāng nín dēngjì, dàn bù néng bǎozhèng yǒu wèizi.

scenarios.title: 舞蹈课后
scenarios.setting: After dance class, the person you danced with comes over.

lines.text: 你跳得真好！学了多久了？
lines.en: You dance really well! How long have you been learning?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tiào de zhēn hǎo! Xué le duō jiǔ le?

lines.text: 谢谢，才学了两个月。你也跳得很好。
lines.en: Thanks, only two months. You dance really well too.
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, cái xué le liǎng ge yuè. Nǐ yě tiào de hěn hǎo.

lines.text: 哪里哪里，我从去年就开始学了。
lines.en: Oh, not really. I've been learning since last year.
lines.pinyin: Nǎli nǎli, wǒ cóng qùnián jiù kāishǐ xué le.

lines.text: 对了，周四下课以后，一起去喝杯咖啡吧？
lines.en: By the way, shall we go for a coffee after Thursday's class?
lines.pinyin: Duì le, zhōusì xiàkè yǐhòu, yìqǐ qù hē bēi kāfēi ba?

lines.text: 好啊！你知道这附近有什么好地方吗？
lines.en: Sure! Do you know any good places around here?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ zhīdào zhè fùjìn yǒu shénme hǎo dìfang ma?

lines.text: 知道，拐角那儿有一家很可爱的咖啡馆。
lines.en: Yes, there's a really cute café just around the corner.
lines.pinyin: Zhīdào, guǎijiǎo nàr yǒu yì jiā hěn kě'ài de kāfēiguǎn.

lines.text: 太好了！那周四见。
lines.en: Great! See you Thursday, then.
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nà zhōusì jiàn.

scenarios.title: 配对成功
scenarios.setting: You matched on a dating app and start chatting.

lines.text: 你好！你和狗的照片太可爱了，是你养的吗？
lines.en: Hi! Your photo with the dog is so cute. Is it yours?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ hé gǒu de zhàopiàn tài kě'ài le, shì nǐ yǎng de ma?

lines.text: 哈哈，是的，它叫豆豆，在家里它最大。
lines.en: Haha, yes, his name is Doudou. He's the boss at home.
lines.pinyin: Hāha, shì de, tā jiào Dòudou, zài jiā li tā zuì dà.

lines.text: 好可爱！那你不遛狗的时候喜欢做什么？
lines.en: So cute! So what do you like doing when you're not walking the dog?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài! Nà nǐ bú liù gǒu de shíhou xǐhuan zuò shénme?

lines.text: 我喜欢做饭，周末常常去爬山。你呢？
lines.en: I like cooking, and I often go hiking on weekends. And you?
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zuò fàn, zhōumò chángcháng qù pá shān. Nǐ ne?

lines.text: 我比较喜欢看电影、听演唱会。要不要找时间见个面？
lines.en: I'm more into movies and concerts. Want to find a time to meet up?
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng, tīng yǎnchànghuì. Yào bu yào zhǎo shíjiān jiàn ge miàn?

lines.text: 好啊！周五下午怎么样？
lines.en: Sure! How about Friday afternoon?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ zěnmeyàng?

lines.text: 没问题，周五我再发消息确认。
lines.en: No problem. I'll message you on Friday to confirm.
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, zhōuwǔ wǒ zài fā xiāoxi quèrèn.

scenarios.title: 见家长
scenarios.setting: Your partner Xiaoming has brought you home for dinner with his parents.

lines.text: 快进来，快进来！早就想见见你了。
lines.en: Come in, come in! We've wanted to meet you for so long.
lines.pinyin: Kuài jìnlai, kuài jìnlai! Zǎo jiù xiǎng jiànjian nǐ le.

lines.text: 阿姨好，叔叔好！这是一点儿水果，一点儿心意。
lines.en: Hello, Auntie! Hello, Uncle! Here's some fruit, just a small gift.
lines.pinyin: Āyí hǎo, shūshu hǎo! Zhè shì yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ, yìdiǎnr xīnyì.

lines.text: 哎呀，来就来吧，还带什么东西！快坐。
lines.en: Oh my, you didn't need to bring anything! Sit down.
lines.pinyin: Āiyā, lái jiù lái ba, hái dài shénme dōngxi! Kuài zuò.

lines.text: 谢谢阿姨。小明常说您做的菜特别好吃。
lines.en: Thank you, Auntie. Xiaoming always says your cooking is amazing.
lines.pinyin: Xièxie āyí. Xiǎo Míng cháng shuō nín zuò de cài tèbié hǎochī.

lines.text: 他就会夸我！你们俩是怎么认识的？
lines.en: He's just flattering me! How did you two meet?
lines.pinyin: Tā jiù huì kuā wǒ! Nǐmen liǎ shì zěnme rènshi de?

lines.text: 在舞蹈课上认识的。一开始我总跳错，他特别有耐心。
lines.en: We met at a dance class. At first I kept getting it wrong, but he was really patient.
lines.pinyin: Zài wǔdǎo kè shang rènshi de. Yì kāishǐ wǒ zǒng tiào cuò, tā tèbié yǒu nàixīn.

lines.text: 真好！来，多吃点儿，别客气。
lines.en: How lovely! Here, have plenty, don't be shy.
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Lái, duō chī diǎnr, bié kèqi.

scenarios.title: 在酒店前台
scenarios.setting: You arrive at your hotel in Beijing.

lines.text: 晚上好，欢迎光临！请问您有预订吗？
lines.en: Good evening, welcome! Do you have a reservation?
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshang hǎo, huānyíng guānglín! Qǐngwèn nín yǒu yùdìng ma?

lines.text: 有，名字是王丽。
lines.en: Yes, the name is Wang Li.
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, míngzi shì Wáng Lì.

lines.text: 好的，一间双人房，住三个晚上，对吗？
lines.en: OK, one double room for three nights, right?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, yì jiān shuāngrénfáng, zhù sān ge wǎnshang, duì ma?

lines.text: 对。早饭几点开始？
lines.en: Right. What time does breakfast start?
lines.pinyin: Duì. Zǎofàn jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?

lines.text: 早上七点到十点，在二楼。
lines.en: From seven to ten in the morning, on the second floor.
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshang qī diǎn dào shí diǎn, zài èr lóu.

lines.text: 房间里有无线网吗？
lines.en: Is there wifi in the room?
lines.pinyin: Fángjiān li yǒu wúxiànwǎng ma?

lines.text: 有，密码在房卡上。祝您入住愉快！
lines.en: Yes, the password is on your key card. Enjoy your stay!
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, mìmǎ zài fángkǎ shang. Zhù nín rùzhù yúkuài!

scenarios.title: 房间出了问题
scenarios.setting: The air conditioning in your room isn't working, so you call the front desk.

lines.text: 你好，我是二零四房间的。空调坏了。
lines.en: Hi, I'm in room 204. The air conditioning is broken.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì èr líng sì fángjiān de. Kōngtiáo huài le.

lines.text: 真不好意思。您试过遥控器了吗？
lines.en: I'm so sorry. Have you tried the remote?
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi. Nín shì guo yáokòngqì le ma?

lines.text: 试过了，可是一直吹热风。
lines.en: I have, but it keeps blowing hot air.
lines.pinyin: Shì guo le, kěshì yìzhí chuī rèfēng.

lines.text: 明白了，我马上让维修师傅过去。
lines.en: I see, I'll send the repairman over right away.
lines.pinyin: Míngbai le, wǒ mǎshàng ràng wéixiū shīfu guòqu.

lines.text: 谢谢。大概要多久？
lines.en: Thanks. About how long will it take?
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Dàgài yào duō jiǔ?

lines.text: 十五分钟左右。修不好的话，我们给您换房间。
lines.en: About fifteen minutes. If it can't be fixed, we'll change your room.
lines.pinyin: Shíwǔ fēnzhōng zuǒyòu. Xiū bu hǎo de huà, wǒmen gěi nín huàn fángjiān.

lines.text: 好的，那我等着。
lines.en: OK, I'll wait then.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, nà wǒ děngzhe.

scenarios.title: 延长住宿
scenarios.setting: You'd like two more nights and a late checkout.

lines.text: 你好，如果可以的话，我想再住两个晚上。
lines.en: Hi, if possible, I'd like to stay two more nights.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, rúguǒ kěyǐ de huà, wǒ xiǎng zài zhù liǎng ge wǎnshang.

lines.text: 我查一下……可以，不过您需要换一个房间。
lines.en: Let me check… Yes, but you'd need to change rooms.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ chá yíxià… Kěyǐ, búguò nín xūyào huàn yí ge fángjiān.

lines.text: 没问题。价格一样吗？
lines.en: No problem. Is the price the same?
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Jiàgé yíyàng ma?

lines.text: 周末贵一点儿，一晚六百八十块。
lines.en: Weekends are a little more: 680 yuan a night.
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò guì yìdiǎnr, yì wǎn liùbǎi bāshí kuài.

lines.text: 好的。最后一天可以晚一点儿退房吗？
lines.en: OK. Can I check out a little later on the last day?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Zuìhòu yì tiān kěyǐ wǎn yìdiǎnr tuìfáng ma?

lines.text: 当然可以，下午两点以前退房不另外收费。
lines.en: Of course. Checking out before 2 p.m. costs nothing extra.
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn yǐqián tuìfáng bú lìngwài shōufèi.

lines.text: 太好了，谢谢您的帮助。
lines.en: Great, thank you for your help.
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, xièxie nín de bāngzhù.

scenarios.title: 求职面试
scenarios.setting: You're interviewing for a job as a sales assistant at a bookshop.

lines.text: 你好，先简单介绍一下你自己吧。
lines.en: Hello, start by briefly introducing yourself.
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, xiān jiǎndān jièshào yíxià nǐ zìjǐ ba.

lines.text: 您好，我叫李明，在服装店工作过三年。
lines.en: Hello, my name is Li Ming. I worked in a clothing store for three years.
lines.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng, zài fúzhuāngdiàn gōngzuò guo sān nián.

lines.text: 你为什么想来书店工作？
lines.en: Why do you want to work at a bookshop?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme xiǎng lái shūdiàn gōngzuò?

lines.text: 我很喜欢看书，也喜欢给别人推荐好书。
lines.en: I love reading, and I like recommending good books to people.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan kàn shū, yě xǐhuan gěi biérén tuījiàn hǎo shū.

lines.text: 周末可以上班吗？
lines.en: Can you work weekends?
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò kěyǐ shàngbān ma?

lines.text: 可以，周六都行，周日有时候也可以。
lines.en: Yes. Saturdays are always fine, and sometimes Sundays too.
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, zhōuliù dōu xíng, zhōurì yǒu shíhou yě kěyǐ.

lines.text: 好的，我们周五通知你。
lines.en: OK, we'll let you know on Friday.
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒmen zhōuwǔ tōngzhī nǐ.

scenarios.title: 谈谈你的优点
scenarios.setting: A second interview for a marketing job.

lines.text: 你觉得自己最大的优点是什么？
lines.en: What do you think is your greatest strength?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zìjǐ zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì shénme?

lines.text: 我觉得我做事很有条理，压力大的时候也能做好。
lines.en: I think I'm very organized, and I do well even under pressure.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde wǒ zuòshì hěn yǒu tiáolǐ, yālì dà de shíhou yě néng zuò hǎo.

lines.text: 能举个具体的例子吗？
lines.en: Can you give a concrete example?
lines.pinyin: Néng jǔ ge jùtǐ de lìzi ma?

lines.text: 上一份工作中，客户把日期提前了，我两周就完成了一个推广活动。
lines.en: In my last job, the client moved the date up, and I finished a campaign in just two weeks.
lines.pinyin: Shàng yí fèn gōngzuò zhōng, kèhù bǎ rìqī tíqián le, wǒ liǎng zhōu jiù wánchéng le yí ge tuīguǎng huódòng.

lines.text: 不错。那你觉得自己哪方面还需要提高？
lines.en: Not bad. And what do you think you still need to improve?
lines.pinyin: Búcuò. Nà nǐ juéde zìjǐ nǎ fāngmiàn hái xūyào tígāo?

lines.text: 我有时候不太会分配任务，不过我正在学着更信任团队。
lines.en: Sometimes I'm not great at delegating, but I'm learning to trust the team more.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou bú tài huì fēnpèi rènwu, búguò wǒ zhèngzài xuézhe gèng xìnrèn tuánduì.

lines.text: 这个回答很坦诚。
lines.en: That's a very candid answer.
lines.pinyin: Zhège huídá hěn tǎnchéng.

scenarios.title: 谈薪资
scenarios.setting: You've been offered the job; now you talk about pay.

lines.text: 我们很希望你加入团队。我们给的月薪是一万五。
lines.en: We'd love you to join the team. The monthly salary we're offering is 15,000.
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen hěn xīwàng nǐ jiārù tuánduì. Wǒmen gěi de yuèxīn shì yíwàn wǔ.

lines.text: 谢谢，我很高兴。不过，我的期望是一万八左右。
lines.en: Thank you, I'm very pleased. However, I was expecting around 18,000.
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ hěn gāoxìng. Búguò, wǒ de qīwàng shì yíwàn bā zuǒyòu.

lines.text: 理解。你的依据是什么？
lines.en: Understood. What's that based on?
lines.pinyin: Lǐjiě. Nǐ de yījù shì shénme?

lines.text: 我的经验，还有市场上类似职位的薪资水平。
lines.en: My experience, and the pay for similar positions on the market.
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de jīngyàn, hái yǒu shìchǎng shang lèisì zhíwèi de xīnzī shuǐpíng.

lines.text: 我们可以给到一万六，再加每周一天居家办公。
lines.en: We can go to 16,000, plus one day a week working from home.
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ gěi dào yíwàn liù, zài jiā měi zhōu yì tiān jūjiā bàngōng.

lines.text: 我觉得挺合理的。半年以后能再谈一次吗？
lines.en: That seems quite reasonable. Could we talk about it again in six months?
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tǐng hélǐ de. Bàn nián yǐhòu néng zài tán yí cì ma?

lines.text: 当然，我们会写进合同里。
lines.en: Of course, we'll write it into the contract.
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán, wǒmen huì xiě jìn hétong li.

scenarios.title: 在书店
scenarios.setting: In a bookshop, someone is browsing the same shelf as you.

lines.text: 不好意思，我忍不住想说，你选书的品味真好。
lines.en: Sorry, I couldn't help saying: you have great taste in books.
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ rěn bu zhù xiǎng shuō, nǐ xuǎn shū de pǐnwèi zhēn hǎo.

lines.text: 哈哈，谢谢！你也喜欢看推理小说吗？
lines.en: Haha, thanks! Do you like mystery novels too?
lines.pinyin: Hāha, xièxie! Nǐ yě xǐhuan kàn tuīlǐ xiǎoshuō ma?

lines.text: 特别喜欢。你推荐哪本？
lines.en: I love them. Which one would you recommend?
lines.pinyin: Tèbié xǐhuan. Nǐ tuījiàn nǎ běn?

lines.text: 这本超级好看，我两个晚上就看完了。
lines.en: This one is amazing. I finished it in two nights.
lines.pinyin: Zhè běn chāojí hǎokàn, wǒ liǎng ge wǎnshang jiù kàn wán le.

lines.text: 那我就买这本。要不要一起喝杯咖啡，你给我讲讲，不剧透？
lines.en: Then I'll buy it. Want to grab a coffee and tell me about it, no spoilers?
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ jiù mǎi zhè běn. Yào bu yào yìqǐ hē bēi kāfēi, nǐ gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang, bú jùtòu?

lines.text: 好啊，保证不剧透！
lines.en: Sure, no spoilers, I promise!
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, bǎozhèng bú jùtòu!

scenarios.title: 知识竞赛之夜
scenarios.setting: Your team just lost trivia night to the next table, by one point.

lines.text: 我们又赢了！要不要我给你补补课？
lines.en: We won again! Want me to give you some tutoring?
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yòu yíng le! Yào bu yào wǒ gěi nǐ bǔbu kè?

lines.text: 哟，挺自恋的嘛。那是运气好。
lines.en: Ooh, a little full of yourself. That was luck.
lines.pinyin: Yō, tǐng zìliàn de ma. Nà shì yùnqi hǎo.

lines.text: 运气？我看到你答地理题的时候犹豫了。
lines.en: Luck? I saw you hesitate on the geography question.
lines.pinyin: Yùnqi? Wǒ kàndào nǐ dá dìlǐ tí de shíhou yóuyù le.

lines.text: 别装了，音乐那题我答对了，你们可没有。
lines.en: Stop pretending. I got the music question right, and you didn't.
lines.pinyin: Bié zhuāng le, yīnyuè nà tí wǒ dá duì le, nǐmen kě méiyǒu.

lines.text: 好吧，那题算你厉害。下周再比一次？
lines.en: Fine, you got me on that one. Rematch next week?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà tí suàn nǐ lìhai. Xià zhōu zài bǐ yí cì?

lines.text: 一言为定。谁输了谁请喝饮料。
lines.en: It's a deal. Whoever loses buys the drinks.
lines.pinyin: Yì yán wéi dìng. Shéi shū le shéi qǐng hē yǐnliào.

lines.text: 没问题，你准备好钱包吧。
lines.en: No problem. Get your wallet ready.
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo qiánbāo ba.

scenarios.title: 软件上的好开场
scenarios.setting: You matched on an app. You open the conversation.

lines.text: 两真一假，你先来。
lines.en: Two truths and a lie, you go first.
lines.pinyin: Liǎng zhēn yì jiǎ, nǐ xiān lái.

lines.text: 哈哈，好：我会说三种语言，跑过马拉松，还怕鸽子。
lines.en: Haha, okay: I speak three languages, I've run a marathon, and I'm scared of pigeons.
lines.pinyin: Hāha, hǎo: wǒ huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán, pǎo guo mǎlāsōng, hái pà gēzi.

lines.text: 嗯……我猜马拉松是假的。鸽子确实挺吓人的。
lines.en: Hmm… I'd guess the marathon is the lie. Pigeons really are scary.
lines.pinyin: Ńg… wǒ cāi mǎlāsōng shì jiǎ de. Gēzi quèshí tǐng xiàrén de.

lines.text: 猜错了！我最多只跑过五公里。该你了。
lines.en: Wrong! The most I've ever run is five kilometers. Your turn.
lines.pinyin: Cāi cuò le! Wǒ zuìduō zhǐ pǎo guo wǔ gōnglǐ. Gāi nǐ le.

lines.text: 我还是当面告诉你吧。周六一起喝杯咖啡？
lines.en: I'd rather tell you in person. Coffee on Saturday?
lines.pinyin: Wǒ háishi dāngmiàn gàosu nǐ ba. Zhōuliù yìqǐ hē bēi kāfēi?

lines.text: 好主意！下午四点，在西湖边见？
lines.en: Good idea! Four o'clock, by West Lake?
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyi! Xiàwǔ sì diǎn, zài Xī Hú biān jiàn?

lines.text: 太好了，周六见！
lines.en: Great, see you Saturday!
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, zhōuliù jiàn!
